Metadata.title: Hotel Mirë | A Boutique Stay in Sarandë
Metadata.description: Life is good by the sea. Discover Hotel Mirë, a boutique coastal retreat in Sarandë with sea-view rooms, slow mornings, and Mediterranean charm.

Hero.title: Life is good
Hero.description: Open balcony doors. A slower morning. The Ionian stretching endlessly ahead. Welcome to your little corner of the Riviera.
Hero.caption: A boutique stay, a little closer to the sea
Hero.imageAlt: A sunlit stone terrace overlooking the blue Ionian Sea

OurStory.title: Somewhere to
OurStory.intro: Some places ask you to see everything. Here, you can simply open the balcony doors and let the day come to you.
OurStory.paragraphOne: Overlooking the Ionian in Sarandë, Hotel Mirë is a small coastal retreat with eighteen thoughtfully considered rooms. Natural textures, soft linens, and a welcoming spirit make it easy to settle in.
OurStory.paragraphTwo: Start with breakfast on the rooftop terrace. Spend the afternoon finding your favourite stretch of coastline. Come back to a quiet balcony as the light softens over the bay. There is no particular rush.
OurStory.seaDescription: Salt in the air, blue on the horizon, and a beach day whenever you feel like it.
OurStory.coffeeDescription: Fresh coffee, local flavours, and breakfast best enjoyed without a hurry.
OurStory.sunDescription: Head out and explore, or settle into the simple pleasure of doing very little.

Rooms.title: Rest comes
Rooms.intro: Three ways to settle in. Each with thoughtful details, space to slow down, and a character of its own.

garden.name: Garden Double
garden.description: A quiet hideaway with soft linens, natural textures, and a private terrace opening onto greenery.
garden.alt: Warm boutique hotel bedroom opening onto a leafy private terrace

sea.name: Sea View Double
sea.description: Wake to the blue of the Ionian. Open the balcony doors, pour a coffee, and take your time.
sea.alt: Elegant double bedroom with a balcony overlooking the Ionian Sea
sea.feature: Your own slice of the sea

suite.name: Riviera Suite
suite.description: Room to unwind, a sunlit sitting area, and a generous terrace made for lingering a little longer.
suite.alt: Spacious coastal hotel suite with a sitting area and sea-facing terrace
suite.feature: A little more room to linger

Experience.title: Less rushing.
Experience.intro: The best part of your stay might be the moment you stop making plans.
Experience.description: A breakfast that stretches into the morning. An afternoon shaped by the sea. One more conversation as the sun slips away. At Mirë, simple pleasures set the pace.
Experience.imageAlt: Breakfast for two on a sunlit terrace overlooking the Ionian Sea
Experience.imageCaption: Some views deserve your whole afternoon.
Experience.breakfastDescription: Start on the rooftop terrace with fresh bread, seasonal fruit, local cheese, and coffee. Stay for the view.
Experience.coastDescription: Find a quiet place to swim, wander along the waterfront, or ask us for a favourite spot. The day is yours to shape.
Experience.eveningDescription: Return to your balcony, settle into the soft evening light, and watch the colours change over the Ionian.
